sql: SELECT c.remote_jid, c.bot_step, c.bot_data->>'mes' AS mes, m.from_me, to_char(m.timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo', 'DD/MM HH24:MI:SS') AS hora, left(m.content, 60) AS texto, encode(convert_to(left(m.content, 10), 'UTF8'), 'hex') AS hex, m.metadata->>'source' AS origem, (SELECT use_flow_builder FROM wapi_bot_settings b WHERE b.instance_id = w.id) AS flow_builder FROM wapi_messages m JOIN wapi_conversations c ON c.id = m.conversation_id JOIN wapi_instances w ON w.id = c.instance_id JOIN companies co ON co.id = w.company_id WHERE co.name ILIKE '%mega%magic%' AND m.timestamp >= '2026-10-19T15:45:00Z' AND m.timestamp < '2026-10-19T16:00:00Z' AND c.id IN (SELECT conversation_id FROM wapi_messages WHERE content LIKE '%' || chr(8419) || '%' AND from_me = false AND timestamp >= '2026-10-19T15:45:00Z' AND timestamp < '2026-10-19T16:00:00Z') ORDER BY c.remote_jid, m.timestamp
